apps.name: acorn
apps.description: Visual development environment for managing software projects
apps.long_description: Acorn Atelier is a Poppy service app that provides a visual development environment for managing software projects. It is the primary interface for registering git repositories, planning features collaboratively with Poppy, monitoring autonomous code execution, and browsing living project documentation. Acorn reimplements the KitTools workflow as Poppy-native operations — sharing the same file-based data contracts (kit_tools/ directory) so that developers can move seamlessly between the Acorn UI and CLI-based tools like Claude Code.
apps.author: WashingBearLabs
use_cases: Register and manage git repositories as Poppy projects
Plan features collaboratively with Poppy using KitTools specs
Monitor autonomous code execution from coding agents
Browse project documentation, specs, and architecture docs
Run KitTools workflows (plan-feature, execute-feature, validate) from a UI
